messages.subject: no legend whith geom_text
parts:
Dear all,

I use scale_linetype_manual and scale_colour_manual for manual legend.
And the legend is ok

But when I add geom_text my legend changes.

How can I prevent this ?

code:
vggplot1 <- ggplot()+
geom_point(data=data, aes(x.1, y.1))+
geom_point(data=data, aes(x.2, y.2))+
geom_text(data=data, aes(x.1, y.1, label=label.1))+
geom_text(data=data, aes(x.2, y.2, label=label.2))+
geom_line(data=data, aes(x.1, y.1, linetype="1980", colour="1980"))+
geom_line(data=data, aes(x.2, y.2, linetype="1981", colour="1981"))+
scale_linetype_manual(name="Group", values=c("1980"="solid",
"1981"="longdash"))+
scale_colour_manual(name="Group", values=c("1980"="black",
"1981"="red"))
